# S9: implicit placement is on by default under logos. A missing
# logos.toml still enables logosarena; arena = false opts out; plain go
# in a marked module re-executes and applies logos.toml, while a module
# without logos.toml keeps plain go; an explicit negation still loses
# to the appended entry.
env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local
env GOEXPERIMENT=

# Missing logos.toml still enables the experiment under logos.
cd default
logos build -x -o $WORK/default.bin .
stderr 'GOEXPERIMENT=[^ ]*logosarena'
cd ..

# An explicit true enables it.
cd on
logos build -x -o $WORK/on.bin .
stderr 'GOEXPERIMENT=[^ ]*logosarena'
cd ..

# False opts out.
cd off
logos build -x -o $WORK/off.bin .
! stderr 'GOEXPERIMENT=[^ ]*logosarena'
cd ..

# Plain go in a marked module re-executes and applies logos.toml,
# so arena=true is set.
cd godb
go build -x -o $WORK/plain.bin .
stderr 'GOEXPERIMENT=[^ ]*logosarena'
cd ..

# A module without logos.toml keeps plain go: no arena experiment.
cd plain
go build -x -o $WORK/plain-unmarked.bin .
! stderr 'GOEXPERIMENT=[^ ]*logosarena'
cd ..

# An explicit negation still loses to the appended entry.
cd default
env GOEXPERIMENT=nologosarena
logos build -x -o $WORK/neg.bin .
stderr 'GOEXPERIMENT=nologosarena,logosarena'
env GOEXPERIMENT=
cd ..

-- default/go.mod --
module example.com/s9default

go 1.27

-- default/main.lgo --
package main

import "fmt"

func main() { fmt.Println("default") }

-- on/go.mod --
module example.com/s9on

go 1.27

-- on/logos.toml --
[build]
arena = true

-- on/main.lgo --
package main

import "fmt"

func main() { fmt.Println("on") }

-- off/go.mod --
module example.com/s9off

go 1.27

-- off/logos.toml --
[build]
arena = false

-- off/main.lgo --
package main

import "fmt"

func main() { fmt.Println("off") }

-- godb/go.mod --
module example.com/s9go

go 1.27

-- godb/logos.toml --
[build]
arena = true

-- godb/main.go --
package main

import "fmt"

func main() { fmt.Println("go") }

-- plain/go.mod --
module example.com/s9plain

go 1.27

-- plain/main.go --
package main

import "fmt"

func main() { fmt.Println("plain") }
